name: i2c_twoboards_compolling
description: I2C_TwoBoards_ComPolling on two NUCLEO-F446RE wired as its readme draws them (two_boards.json): I2C1 at 400 kHz with the slave's 10-bit own address 0x30F. B1's USER button, read once a second, starts each step: the master sends its 162-byte buffer, which the slave receives, then reads it back from the slave. SCL clocks 164 bytes the first time (the 10-bit address's two bytes and the data: 2954 edges with START and STOP) and 165 the second (the address, a repeated START, the header for reading and the data: 2974). Both boards' buffers then hold the text and LD2 stays on on both (an error would toggle it).
